purpose: Mechanism 4 of phase 1p: every CLAUDE.md rule classified MECHANISM or KNOWLEDGE. A PROPOSAL — nothing here is executed, and this tool does not edit CLAUDE.md. Retiring ratified text is a change to what the governing document says, and that is the user's.
population_derivation: Every register entry whose home is CLAUDE.md, taken from tools/audit/decisions/backbone_decisions.json. The register enumerated that document in full, so the population is derived rather than searched for (protocol P1).

classes.MECHANISM-EXISTS: a mechanism already enforces it, or a stated part of it
classes.MECHANISABLE-AND-NOT: a mechanical form exists and nothing implements it — THE DEFECT CLASS
classes.KNOWLEDGE: it governs a judgment; any mechanical form would miss the point or fire on legitimate work

the_defect_set.strongest_candidate: BUILT at phase 1q. It was D-197/D-198/D-199/D-316, the local patches, stated as do-not-revert against a dependency update — the silent failure a check catches and a reader does not. `tools/audit/local_patches_check.py` now covers them, so they have left the defect set; what remains of D-197 is its distribution constraint, which no check can enforce.

what_was_executed: NO CLAUDE.md TEXT WAS RETIRED, at phase 1p or at phase 1q. That was recorded here as a failure under the test then in force — a mechanism must retire the prose it replaces, or it is apparatus growth — and the USER WITHDREW THAT TEST on 2026-08-03 as a structural proxy standing in for a behavioral quantity, unvalidated (#17d). The test from here is three measured conditions (register entry D-436, homed at cowork_audit_protocol.md): runs automatically with no human step; a measured detection rate against known instances; a measured false-positive rate at or near zero. Four mechanisms now stand against rules in this table (D-196, D-253, D-430/D-432, D-197's group), each with an establishment artifact; none retires prose, and under D-436 that is no longer a defect.

rules.title: Never work from memory instead of documented facts
rules.mechanism_or_ground: PARTIAL. `tools/audit/process_check.py` flags a claim about the code carrying no `file:line`, which is the shape a from-memory assertion arrives in. It cannot tell a wrong recollection from a right one.

rules.title: Music-theory words are reserved for their music-theory meaning
rules.mechanism_or_ground: A word-list check over user-facing text: the twenty collided words are enumerated in the rule itself, and the convention is mechanical — the BARE word carries the musical sense, every non-musical use is qualified. A check would flag a bare `score`, `key`, `measure` or `instrument` used in the non-musical sense. Nothing implements it.

rules.title: The regression stop is the granularity-robust unit; root governs, key and Roman numeral ride beside
rules.mechanism_or_ground: `tools/robust_stop_diff.py` — the class-(b) duration non-increase per preset, exit 0 only if every preset passes.

rules.title: #1 - build only on established fact and theory
rules.mechanism_or_ground: What counts as established fact or published theory is a judgment.

rules.title: #2 - target the specific open question, not the general topic
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Whether a question is the specific open one is a judgment.

rules.title: #3 - an unexpected finding is a failure to diagnose, not a curiosity
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Recognising a surprise is the judgment; a mechanism cannot.

rules.title: #4 - the long-term goal is maximum-precision inference
rules.mechanism_or_ground: A goal, not a checkable condition.

rules.title: #5 - when facts may be scarce, investigate
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Whether facts are scarce is a judgment.

rules.title: #6 - total unification: one path per concern
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Duplicate-detection tooling would flag ordinary similarity; what counts as one concern is the judgment the rule is about.

rules.title: #7 - a layer is enhanced only with what belongs to it
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Layer membership of a method is a design judgment.

rules.title: #8 - no inference-problem-driven coding until every method sits in its correct layer
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Whether a change is inference-problem-driven is a judgment.

rules.title: #9 - measure only on corpora known to be non-stale and accurate
rules.mechanism_or_ground: PARTIAL. `run_bach_preset.py` exits nonzero on an incomplete corpus and `characterise_bir_false.validate_corpus_dir` refuses a dir whose manifest or fingerprints do not match — staleness is mechanical; accuracy is not.

rules.title: #10 - documentation always in sync with code
rules.mechanism_or_ground: PARTIAL. `gen_decisions_register.py --check`, `gen_cluster_dispositions.py --verify` and `tools/open_items_split_check.py` hold three surfaces to their data. Specification prose against code is not covered.

rules.title: #11 - regression tests in sync with code, and run between iterations
rules.mechanism_or_ground: `composing_tests`, `notation_tests` and `pipeline_snapshot_tests` against pinned goldens.

rules.title: #13 - surface a surprise as a stop before building around it
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Recognising the surprise is the act; the rule governs what to do once it is recognised.

rules.title: #14 - every behavior change is one user-ratified, revertible, provenance-stamped commit
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Whether a change alters behavior is what the test suites answer; whether it was ratified is not a property of the diff.

rules.title: #15 - verify at the objects on the full output surface, never at an assertion
rules.mechanism_or_ground: What the full output surface is differs per change.

rules.title: #16 - every measurement is stamped to its corpus and its tooling, and the outgoing reference is snapshotted
rules.mechanism_or_ground: `tools/robust_stop/manifest.json` with `tools/robust_stop_restamp.py`, which regenerates every recorded figure from the candidate summary and is established by reproducing the outgoing manifest exactly.

rules.title: #17 - the Premise Gate
rules.mechanism_or_ground: The premise ledger, the written prediction and the desk simulation are acts of reasoning; a mechanism can check that the artifacts exist, which is not the same as checking that they were done.

rules.title: #18 - an unverified causal premise is forbidden (Class A)
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Whether a premise is load-bearing is a judgment.

rules.title: #19 - an unestablished measurement tool is forbidden (Class B)
rules.mechanism_or_ground: PARTIAL, and by instance rather than centrally: each measurement tool carries its own `--establish` or `--check` (`tools/a8_rebaseline_measure.py`'s self-validation, `process_check.py --establish`, `shell_read_guard.py --establish`). Nothing checks that a NEW tool has one.

rules.title: #20 - fit and evaluation are separated
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Which data helped fit a value is known to the fitter, not to a checker outside it.

rules.title: #21 - ground truth is a measurement tool too, and its accuracy is measured
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Measuring annotator agreement is work, not a check.

rules.title: #22 - every hard gate declares in advance how it handles the largest change it will meet
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Whether a gate's declared protocol covers the largest change it will meet is a judgment about the future.

rules.title: #23 - an end-state principle needs a lawful transition
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Declaring and bounding a migration is a design act.

rules.title: #24 - every reported figure carries its uncertainty
rules.mechanism_or_ground: A check that a reported comparison between two measured quantities carries an interval. `process_check.py` has the adjacent half — it flags a bare quantity — but not the comparison-without-uncertainty shape, which is one of the eight recorded instances it MISSES only because it was not asked to look for it as such.

rules.title: The constrained-optimum ledger corollary
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Recording what the unconstrained best alternative is, is authorship.

rules.title: The scope of surprise, and the three-stage funnel
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Which stage a piece of work is at is a judgment.

rules.title: The decision-neutrality corollary - what exists carries no weight in choosing a design
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Weighing designs is the judgment the rule constrains.

rules.title: The two-tier regression class policy - functional regression stops, rotation churn is tracked
rules.mechanism_or_ground: `tools/robust_stop_diff.py` — the class-(a)/(b) split, with the class-(a) INVESTIGATE flag at its declared threshold.

rules.title: A scoring change and its documentation land in the same commit
rules.mechanism_or_ground: A pre-commit check: a diff that touches a scoring term in `chordanalyzer.cpp` must also touch `docs/scoring_model.md`. The rule states the condition in exactly that form, and the staleness check it names — the template count in §2 against `kTemplateCount` — is arithmetic. Nothing implements either.

rules.title: The writing standards live in one place, and predicates must be qualified
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Qualified predicates and defined terms are properties of prose.

rules.title: No self-invented labels, abbreviations, numbering schemes or jargon
rules.mechanism_or_ground: WEAK but real: a check for newly introduced identifiers of the shape a private numbering scheme takes, against the labels the repository already uses. It would flag candidates for a reader, not decide them.

rules.title: Every design decision carries its defense at its home
rules.mechanism_or_ground: The register's `rationale` field, and the generated count of decisions whose defense the record does not state — a gap that cannot be hidden because the figure is computed.

rules.title: The self-check: re-read the diff against the principles before reporting
rules.mechanism_or_ground: NEW at phase 1p, and only for the document half: `tools/audit/process_check.py` reports a missing self-check section (D-434). Whether the check was actually run over the diff is not mechanical.

rules.title: The distribution constraint - the import-fix patch is fork-local and never goes upstream
rules.mechanism_or_ground: BUILT at phase 1q: `tools/audit/local_patches_check.py` verifies each recorded patch is present at HEAD, deriving its patch list from `CLAUDE.md`'s own section so a newly recorded patch is covered without a code change, and STOPPING on a recorded patch it has no marker for. Established at `tools/audit/local_patches_establishment.json` by detecting deliberately unpatched content. PARTIAL for THIS entry: D-197 is the FORK-LOCAL distribution constraint on D-199's patch, not a patch of its own, and no check enforces a distribution constraint — a push is the act it forbids.

rules.title: The Windows snap fix in the muse submodule is intentional and must not be reverted
rules.mechanism_or_ground: See D-197 — the same check covers the recorded patches. CLAUDE.md's section carries THREE patch subsections; the four entries here include D-197, which is a disposition rather than a patch.

rules.title: The MusicXML declared-mode import fix is intentional and must not be reverted
rules.mechanism_or_ground: See D-197 — the same check covers the recorded patches.

rules.title: Make it work first; compromise on performance only if performance proves a problem
rules.mechanism_or_ground: A sequencing rule about when a trade-off may be considered.

rules.title: Candidate admission is completion, not refinement - so #8 permits fixing it now
rules.mechanism_or_ground: A ruling about what another rule permits.

rules.title: One fix is designed once over the whole enumerated family, never per symptom
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Whether two faults share a cause is the diagnosis itself.

rules.title: An exotic mode is graded against its parent collection's minor key, not its own tonic triad
rules.mechanism_or_ground: `compare_rn._our_key_tonic` — the one shared reduction every graded surface routes through.

rules.title: Key agreement is reported against both the global home key and the local key
rules.mechanism_or_ground: The dual key column, carried by the measurement tooling wherever the key column appears.

rules.title: The regression stop is abstain-aware: an abstention counts as disagreement on root
rules.mechanism_or_ground: `compare_rn._our_key_ident` for the one abstain decision, and `robust_stop_diff.py`'s flag on any rise in the abstain rate.

rules.title: The decisions register is a mandatory session-start read, and a new ruling lands in the register in the commit that records it
rules.mechanism_or_ground: The same-commit half: a check that a commit touching a ruling surface also touches `backbone_decisions.json`. The mandatory-read half is not mechanisable.

rules.title: Issue-exhaustion and specification completion before any fix design - the three-phase sequencing rule
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Which phase the work is in is a judgment.

rules.title: The whole decision surface is delivered as user-visible text before any choice question
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Whether the user has actually seen a surface is not a property of any file.

rules.title: Working-tree files are read with the file tools; bash is limited to git object queries by explicit hash
rules.mechanism_or_ground: NEW at phase 1p, and it is BUILT BUT NOT ARMED, which keeps it in the defect class. `tools/audit/shell_read_guard.py` is committed and established; arming it means one block in `.claude/settings.json`, which `.gitignore:112` puts OUTSIDE the record — a live control existing only in an untracked file is the OI-285 class. It would cover the TEXT-UTILITY half only, for sessions in this directory; the branch-tip/index half is deliberately not enforced, and coverage of the writing side is not established.

rules.title: Investigate by default; never ask the user whether to investigate or proceed
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Recognising that a step could be measured first is the judgment.

rules.title: The only ground truth is the human annotation; the algorithmic analysis is a filter, and no self-annotation ever enters a measurement
rules.mechanism_or_ground: PARTIAL. The variant-(b) DCML-only unit is the mechanism — the graded surface reads the human annotation and nothing else. That no self-annotation enters a measurement is not separately checked.

rules.title: A newly acquired corpus enters as research material; the frozen regression corpus stays the gate until a deliberate re-baseline
rules.mechanism_or_ground: The corpus manifest could carry an explicit tier, and the gate tooling could refuse to measure against material not marked gate-tier. The rule names exactly that condition, and nothing enforces it — a newly arrived corpus is kept out of the gate by discipline alone.

rules.title: The chord-symbol parser sussus fix is a recorded local patch with an UPSTREAMABLE distribution disposition
rules.mechanism_or_ground: See D-197 — the same check covers the recorded patches.

rules.title: The contract-home criterion's unit is a SECTION of a document, not the document
rules.mechanism_or_ground: `tools/audit/decisions/gen_home_classification.py --check` re-derives every entry's section home from its document's own headings, and the class the criterion gives it. (It replaced `gen_section_homes.py`, which applied this ruling to a staged subset.)

rules.title: What counts as a delegation, graded by form — the clause the section-level criterion did not touch
rules.mechanism_or_ground: APPLIED at phase 1q by the same tool as D-430: the bar's per-document form grade is authored once in `tools/audit/decisions/gen_phase1p_delegation_bar.py`'s FORMS table, whose anchors are LOCATED in the delegating file on every run, so a delegation that moves or is reworded stops the pass rather than passing a stale citation.

rules.title: A shelved section can be a home — shelving is a status, not a kind
rules.mechanism_or_ground: Same tool as D-432; the shelving question never enters its verdict, which is what the ruling says.

rules.title: Delegating to a document and being a home are different tests with different subjects
rules.mechanism_or_ground: The two roles are separate inputs to the same pass and cannot be conflated by it: the DELEGATING side is the fixed list of three user-ratified surfaces the pass searches, and the TARGET side is the home document being graded. A surface being in the first list gives it no standing in the second.
